games.name: Arx Fatalis

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Arx Fatalis ships with EAX off.

games.notes: On Linux, the Arx Libertatis engine reimplementation (arx-libertatis.org) is a strong alternative: it runs natively without Wine or Proton, reuses your Arx Fatalis data files and plays the game's environmental reverb out of the box. Use it or EAX, not both.

steam.store_details: This is the original 2007 BioShock. Unlike 2016's 'BioShock Remastered', which dropped EAX and its reverb (per PCGamingWiki), it's an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships with 'Use Creative EAX Audio' off, which keeps it on DirectSound with no EAX instead of the OpenAL32.dll this script installs.
audio_settings.follow_up: If BioShock starts with EAX turned off, make sure you quit the game from its main menu, otherwise it assumes the game crashed and resets Bioshock.ini to its previous state. If this happens, manually turn on 'Use Creative EAX Audio' in the game's audio settings.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to stereo, so the rear speakers of a 4.0 setup get no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to stereo, so the rest of a 5.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to stereo, so the rest of a 7.1 speaker setup gets no sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: BioShock ships set to plain stereo, so a Pro Logic receiver has no surround information to decode.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: BioShock filters textures at a low level, so floors and walls blur when seen at an angle.

games.name: Deus Ex

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Deus Ex ships with its hardware sound option off, and it only plays EAX reverb with it on.

games.notes: Reverb is used sparingly and is quiet by default — Battery Park, the first mission, is a good place to hear it. The community ALAudio mod doesn't pass the game's EAX reverb through, so stay on the default Galaxy driver (per kcat/dsoal#79).
